assets.name: satellites
assets.prompt: Extract the 17 satellite objects from reference into a transparent SPRITE SHEET with exactly 5 columns and 4 rows, equal rectangular cells, each object centered in its cell and entirely inside cell with 12% transparent padding. Canvas 2500x2000. True transparent background. No gridlines, no labels, no text. Preserve exact original designs, materials and colours. Each sprite includes its OWN rings/accessories but excludes the large dotted orbit tracks and background stars. Cells read left-to-right then top-to-bottom: row1: [pastel rainbow-ringed pink planet from far left], [flower-filled glass globe upper left], [small yellow ringed planet at top], [small mint-green ringed planet at top], [blue-purple ringed planet with star and heart upper right]. Row2: [purple sphere with green umbrella from far right], [turquoise lightning-bolt crystal with golden ring lower right], [yellow gift with pink bow and white wings bottom, without large blue orbital track], [large cyan-to-pink round bubble sphere with two little bubbles and star decorations lower left], [pink crescent cradling cyan star]. Row3: [white bunny-eared sphere], [small cream spotted ringed planet], [pair of purple crystal moons as one sprite], [small peach-pink ringed planet with dangling pink droplet], [small multicolour faceted gem]. Row4: [yellow/pink checkerboard globe with golden ring and star on top], [pair of turquoise and pink magic cards with tiny white wings as one sprite], [EMPTY], [EMPTY], [EMPTY]. No central golden star or castle. Same polished cute 3D rendering as reference. Each sprite uncropped with no overlap into neighbouring cells.
